description: This header file defines prefetch functions for memory optimization, including functions for prefetching data into CPU caches with different locality hints, primarily used for performance tuning in C++ projects.

methods.name: PrefetchToLocalCache
methods.description: Prefetches data into the CPU cache with high temporal locality.

methods.name: PrefetchToLocalCacheNta
methods.description: Prefetches data with non-temporal (short-term) locality, avoiding cache retention.

methods.name: PrefetchToLocalCacheForWrite
methods.description: Prefetches data with intent to modify, potentially invalidating cache lines.
